{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:27.451
    | text      = This guy interviewing Tucker is Clayton Morris, one of the hosts of Redacted News.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:32.791
    | text      = He and his wife were real estate folks, and, uh, he was a host on
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:36.051
    | text      = Fox & Friends for a bit, but weirdly, in 2019, they up and moved to Portugal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.571
    | text      = His wife claimed, quote, "I'm not one of those who rejects
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.711
    | text      = America. We had a good life there, but my husband and I have had a hard
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.171
    | text      = few years in our business, and this collective soul challenge
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.431
    | text      = forced us to question everything." This
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:52.831
    | text      = collective soul challenge doesn't involve the '90s grunge band Collective
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.230
    | text      = Soul. Instead, it's a reference to a barrage of lawsuits that Clayton had filed against him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.370
    | text      = alleging fraudulent business practices.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.091
    | text      = Sure. Sure, sure, sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.571
    | text      = So here's the basic sketch of these lawsuits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.971
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.691
    | text      = It was alleged that Clayton organized the sale of properties in Indiana to folks living out of state
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.811
    | text      = with the understanding that the properties would be rehabbed and then rented
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.171
    | text      = out, and his business would take care of all of that process.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:19.010
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:19.350
    | text      = These out-of-state parties were, in essence, investors in the purchase and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.750
    | text      = flipping of these rental properties.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.171
    | text      = The New York T- uh, Times describes the plan like this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.331
    | text      = Quote, "Their plan was to connect mom-and-pop investors with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:32.711
    | text      = turnkey investment homes in Detroit; Indianapolis; Jacksonville, Florida; and several other cities.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.291
    | text      = Their company, Morris Invest, would handle all the details,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.451
    | text      = finding properties, overseeing renovations, hiring property managers to rent out the houses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:46.951
    | text      = All clients had to do was put up the cash and wait for their checks to arrive."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.591
    | text      = Hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.350
    | text      = So this started to become a problem because investors started learning that these
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:54.730
    | text      = properties were not being renovated and-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.571
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.671
    | text      = ... in some cases, were sold without the full disclosure of their circumstances.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:00.490
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:01.130
    | text      = For instance, one man bought a home that was destroyed in a fire, uh,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.671
    | text      = days after the fire, and he was unaware of that detail.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.691
    | text      = That is-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.971
    | text      = That there had been a fire.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.711
    | text      = Well...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.650
    | text      = In the midst of this fallout, as lawsuits started piling up,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:12.591
    | text      = Clayton and Morris Invest pointed the finger at a company called Ocean Point and its founder Bert Whalen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:18.910
    | text      = Clayton, uh, would, uh, have you know that, uh, he's just a victim in this whole thing, too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:23.691
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:23.910
    | text      = He was, uh, he was just re- referring customers to Ocean Point. W- he w- he was just a middleman. Come on, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:29.691
    | text      = Sure. No big deal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:30.370
    | text      = Cool?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.250
    | text      = So Whelan's lawyer said that Clayton got $6,500 as a referral fee for each sale.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.191
    | text      = And in Indianapolis alone, that would involve 700 homes, racking up a cool $4.5 million.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.010
    | text      = Holy shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:44.110
    | text      = Even if you really believe that he's just this middleman guy who's-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:47.750
    | text      = Goddamn. Crushing it, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:49.071
    | text      = Yeah. So I'm not sure the extent to which Clayton or Morris Invest knew what was up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:53.931
    | text      = and how much they were just happy to feed customers into a fraud racket and collect a fee, but I do
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:58.571
    | text      = know that in 2022, Whalen admitted to federal
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:01.191
    | text      = charges involving conspiracy to commit wire fraud. Part of his confession involved admitting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.211
    | text      = that he had defrauded the investors, going so far as to create
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:08.971
    | text      = fake leases to trick them into thinking that their properties were occupied by tenants,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:15.410
    | text      = ready to be rented, or in some cases, were vacant lots. He also commingled some rent payments from
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = actually occupied properties and, quote,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:26.191
    | text      = pool of funds in order to silence investors who voiced concerns
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.431
    | text      = and evade detection of the fraud." So essentially,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.331
    | text      = Bert Whalen and Ocean Point were running a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:34.571
    | text      = real estate fraud pyramid scheme, and whether or not Clayton Morris
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
